TREATMENT OF DEEP VEIN THRMBOSIS
Non-drug Treatment
Avoid stasis, by encouraging ambulation and some degree of physical activity
Drug Treatment
- Achieve APTT of 1.5 to 2.5 of control:
- Heparin 5000 - 10,000 units by intravenous injection followed by
subcutaneous injection of 15,000 units every 12 hours or intravenous
infusion at 15 - 25 units/kg/hr, with close laboratory monitoring.
- Warfarin 1 - 5 mg orally daily for 6 - 12 weeks.
- Maintain Target INR at 2 – 2.5
